## Checklist

- [ ] No Apple, Qualcomm or Motorola material, device dumps, raw logs, secrets or personal paths.
- [ ] No weakened signature, trust, memory-protection or lockdown behaviour.
- [ ] Generated status files regenerated, not hand-edited (if affected).
